raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
CVE-2026-114145 affects GitPython before 3.2.1. The `main` lockfile already resolves 3.2.1, but its dependency override and Framework system-Python install still allow an older vulnerable release.

Raise both minimums to GitPython 3.2.1 while retaining the `<4` upper bound. The lockfile's resolved package stays at 3.2.1; its override manifest reflects the new minimum.

Validation: `uv lock --check` in the project container, `uv run --no-sync pre-commit run --all-files`, and `git diff --check`. CI and a rebuilt image scan remain pending.

No verified findings. The [project override](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/d592b6eb5f91a663d4d7caf820feb6eed9c741a2/pyproject.toml#L136-L137), [lockfile manifest](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/d592b6eb5f91a663d4d7caf820feb6eed9c741a2/uv.lock#L24), and [Framework installation](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/d592b6eb5f91a663d4d7caf820feb6eed9c741a2/docker/Dockerfile.fw_final#L106) consistently require `GitPython>=3.2.1,<4`. The resolved package and artifact hashes remain unchanged at 3.2.1.

Static review only; validation commands and image builds were not executed.

### Suggested test cases
- Proposed `gitpython_lock_consistency`: run `uv lock --check` inside the project container; expect success without lockfile changes.
- Proposed `gitpython_framework_versions`: rebuild the Framework image and check GitPython using both `/usr/bin/python3` and `/opt/venv/bin/python`; expect `>=3.2.1,<4` in each environment.
- No perf tests impacted.

*Review generated by codex. This was a full review. Request a full review with `/review reset=true`.*

detail.body:
CVE-2026-114145 affects GitPython before 3.2.1. The `main` lockfile already resolves 3.2.1, but its dependency override and Framework system-Python install still allow an older vulnerable release.

Raise both minimums to GitPython 3.2.1 while retaining the `<4` upper bound. The lockfile's resolved package stays at 3.2.1; its override manifest reflects the new minimum.

Validation: `uv lock --check` in the project container, `uv run --no-sync pre-commit run --all-files`, and `git diff --check`. CI and a rebuilt image scan remain pending.
detail.title: build(security): require GitPython 3.2.1 on main

files.patch:
@@ -103,7 +103,7 @@ RUN pip install "fastapi==0.139.1" \
     "jupyterlab>=4.5.10" \
     "jupyter-server>=2.20.0" \
     "mistune>=3.3.0" \
-    "GitPython>=3.1.62,<4" && \
+    "GitPython>=3.2.1,<4" && \
     # pip targets system Python; explicitly remove the virtualenv copy too.
     uv pip uninstall --python /opt/venv/bin/python opencv-python-headless && \
     uv pip uninstall --python /usr/bin/python3 --system --break-system-packages \

@@ -21,7 +21,7 @@ overrides = [
     { name = "cryptography", specifier = ">=50.0.0,<51" },
     { name = "fast-hadamard-transform", git = "https://github.com/Dao-AILab/fast-hadamard-transform.git?rev=v1.1.0" },
     { name = "fastapi", specifier = "<0.139.2" },
-    { name = "gitpython", specifier = ">=3.1.62,<4" },
+    { name = "gitpython", specifier = ">=3.2.1,<4" },
     { name = "imageio", marker = "sys_platform == 'never'" },
     { name = "imageio-ffmpeg", marker = "sys_platform == 'never'" },
     { name = "langchain", specifier = ">=0.3.28" },
